title: Ovid2 data-health check package (EDC/DC report cycle)
description: One EDC / Data-Characterization report cycle (e.g. '20r1', '20r2'). A package groups the health checks that ship in that cycle by listing their check ids. Packages may share checks: the same check id can appear in several packages. Each quarter a new package manifest is dropped in; it lists the newly-added checks plus the shared ones carried forward. Check specs stay unaware of packages (a check is just referenced by id). The `ovid2 health` runner resolves a requested package to the union of its member check ids.

label.description: Human-friendly label shown in pickers (e.g. '2020 R1 (baseline)').

released.description: ISO-8601 date the cycle was added. Packages are ordered by this date, most recent first; the newest is the picker default.

checks.description: Check ids (matching a spec's `id` or `name`) that belong to this cycle. Referenced ids must resolve in the check registry.
